meaning: Pricing power, discount discipline and product/service mix after all cost of sales.
management_action: Tighten discretionary e-bike discounting, shift mix to higher-margin brands/accessories, negotiate volume rebates.

meaning: Profit left after running the store, before financing and tax.
management_action: Flex seasonal staffing to demand, convert unapplied technician time to billable service, review freight and storage spend.

meaning: Bottom-line return on each dollar of revenue after interest and tax.
management_action: Combine margin and opex actions; reduce revolver usage to cut interest.

meaning: Cash-like operating earnings before depreciation; comparable across financing structures.
management_action: Same levers as operating margin; EBITDA excludes the fixed depreciation of the fit-out.

formula: TTM net income / average total assets
meaning: How productively the branch uses the assets it holds (mostly inventory).
management_action: Release inventory (the largest asset) through seasonal reorder points and clearance of slow movers.

formula: TTM net income / average total equity
meaning: Return earned on the head-office capital allocated to Calgary.
management_action: Improve profit and return surplus summer cash to head office instead of holding idle balances.

meaning: Ability to meet obligations due within a year from short-term assets.
management_action: Healthy; avoid letting seasonal revolver draws push it below 1.5x.

meaning: Liquidity without relying on selling inventory.
management_action: Hold a minimum cash buffer; quick ratio dips during the pre-season build when cash funds stock.
Summer cash peaks exceed needs - sweep surplus to head office or prepay the term loan.

meaning: Net short-term resources funding day-to-day operations.
management_action: Size the revolver to the Feb-Apr working-capital peak; avoid tying cash in slow-moving SKUs.

meaning: How many times stock is sold and replaced per year.
management_action: Order to seasonal demand (Model 4 reorder points), cut winter cover, clear aged stock before spring.

meaning: Days of stock held; ties up cash and drives carrying cost.
management_action: Target fewer days on hand for C-class SKUs and international brands with long lead times.

formula: Average receivables / (TTM net revenue x 1.05 GST) x 365
meaning: Days to collect card, financing, fleet and warranty receivables.
management_action: Already short (card settlements); keep fleet/warranty claims on 30/45-day follow-up.

formula: Average accounts payable / TTM total cost of sales x 365
meaning: Days of supplier credit used to fund inventory.
management_action: Move 'Prepaid/Net 15' brands to Net 30 and remove deposits where volume justifies it.

meaning: Days between paying for stock and collecting from customers; lower frees cash.
management_action: Lower DIO and raise DPO - every 10 days of CCC is roughly $50K of cash at the current cost base.

formula: TTM net revenue / average total assets
meaning: Revenue generated per dollar of assets.
management_action: Grow sales per square foot (service, accessories attach) without adding inventory.

meaning: Reliance on borrowed versus head-office capital.
management_action: Low; keep revolver usage seasonal and fully repaid by June.

meaning: Headroom to service interest from operating profit (lenders often want > 3x).
management_action: Thin because EBIT is thin; profit improvement matters more than refinancing.

formula: TTM EBITDA / (TTM interest + TTM scheduled principal)
meaning: Ability to meet all scheduled debt payments from operating cash earnings (> 1.25x typical covenant).
management_action: Below 1.25x would breach a typical covenant - prioritise EBITDA improvement and avoid new term debt.
